title: Query Performance Comparison: RDBMS vs Graph Database
description: This interactive Chart.js visualization demonstrates the dramatic performance differences between relational databases using JOIN operations and graph databases using index-free adjacency for multi-hop relationship queries in healthcare data systems.
subject: Mathematics
topic: Query Performance Comparison: RDBMS vs Graph Database
author: Dan McCreary
learningObjectives: Compare the exponential growth of RDBMS JOIN query times against the near-constant traversal times of a graph database as relationship hops increase
Explain how index-free adjacency lets a graph database hold query time near 3ms to 17ms from 1 to 6 hops
Interpret a logarithmic Y-axis where gridlines mark powers of ten spanning 1ms to 850,000ms
Calculate the roughly 60,000-fold performance gap between the two systems at 5 relationship hops
Evaluate which multi-hop healthcare queries, such as Patient to Diagnosis to Treatment to Medication, are impractical in an RDBMS at real-time latency
